Herod and this broken world will be left behind and be a distant memory and
everything will be made new and right. Will you pray with me? Almighty God we come
before you now as your servants and you reign. We confess that you reign. Lord we
do not know what the future holds for us. We don't know the suffering and the pain
that tomorrow might bring. But Lord we pray that you would give us confidence
because we know that suffering and pain will not be the final word for those
whose lives are hidden in you. Instead, it will be eternal joy, eternal delight of worshipping
you before your throne. So Lord, we pray that you would come quickly and make all things
new. We pray this in the powerful name of your son, Jesus. Amen.
